Name: Vanilla Vegetation Tweaks
Author: revenantFun
Description:
[size=3][center][/center]I love CA's pixel style, I find it wonderfully charming, but there have always been a few things that bugged me here and there. I've had these adjusted on my end for ages--but these have all been private mods up until now! I've finally decided to combine them into one pack and release them into the wild. The changes are as follows:

[/size]
[u][size=5]Trees[/size][/u]
[size=5]  [/size]
[size=4]- Slight adjustments to colouration for Spring and Fall trees, using palettes sourced from the (much nicer!) tree colour variants seen as decorations outside the playable area on outdoor maps
[/size]
[list][left][*][i][size=3]Fall maple trees are a warmer, less magenta-looking red[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]Fall pine trees are a warmer green and their trunks are a much richer, darker brown[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]Fall mahogany trees are less washed-out, with darker shadows to more closely resemble the rest of the original pre-1.5 trees[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]Spring cherry trees are no longer electric neon magenta and are instead a gentler, more Spring-y pink[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]Minor edits to many other fruit tree varieties to increase/reduce contrast for a more cohesive overall look[/size][/i]
[*][size=3][i]Apricot trees edited to have cleaner, less blocky shading, more in line with the other trees[/i][/size]
[/left][/list][size=4]- Edits to "mossy" variants of trees
[/size]
[list]
[*][i][size=3]the moss on Oak trees in Fall, Spring, and Summer has been made to look less like a mysterious, dripping green ooze [/size][size=4]*[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]a few different mosses are now an earthier, warmer green and blended better with the bark underneath so as to look more naturalistic[/size][/i]
[/list][size=4]- Integration of my edits of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2852735]JefGrizli[/url]'s wonderful [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24118]Refitted Winter Tree Sprites[/url][/size]

[list]
[*][i][size=3]fruit trees switch to an icier palette in Winter, lose their leaves, and get snowed on--just like their non-fruit cousins do[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]fruit trees in the greenhouse keep their warm-weather colours year-round[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]Spring apricot and peach trees bloom in two different pinkish hues (Jef's original colourways, small edits by me where mentioned above)[/size][/i]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Grasses[/u]

[/size][size=4]- Hand-edited grass sprites for all grass variants and seasons[/size]

[list]
[*][i][size=3]shorter grass by roughly 50% -- just short enough to let you actually see where your chickens are![/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]overall original grass shape preserved; length taken from the middle so as not to break the shadows or alter the look of the individual leaves[/size][/i]
[*][i][size=3]retains the same amount of flowers/decorative additions as vanilla[/size][/i]
[/list]

[right][size=4]*[/size] [size=1](I know that that's a real type of moss that exists, but it just looked really weird to me. The valley isn't a rainforest! temperate or otherwise!)﻿[/size][/right]

[center][url=https://ibb.co/Nn3TyFZb][img]https://i.ibb.co/YTW0LNpw/combined.gif[/img]
(click the gifs to play)[/url][/center]

[size=5][u]Compatibility Notes:[/u][/size]
- Will only be compatible with vanilla colour schemes.
- Not compatible (and will not be remade to be compatible) with any overhaul/redraw/recolour mods.
- Will not apply to any new sprites added by other mods.
- Will not play nice with other mods that edit the same files (trees, fruit trees, and grass mods).

[size=5][u]Installation:[/u][/size]
- Extract .zip into the Mods folder located inside your Stardew Valley install. Done!

[size=5][u]Uninstallation:[/u][/size]
- Delete the [b][b][CP] Vanilla Vegetation Tweaks[/b][/b] folder from your [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.

[size=5][u]Acknowledgements:[/u][/size]
- thank you again to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2852735]JefGrizli[/url] for graciously allowing their mod to be used as a free modder's resource; I downloaded your mod pretty much as soon as you dropped it, and being able to fold it into my personal edits was ideal! you're a star 🌟



﻿[i]thanks for visiting! happy farming (:[/i]
